critic.verdict: Right story, timid execution: a claimed 1.4-to-1.0 pull-back for isolation was clamped to about 1.22-to-1.0, so the runner never dominates and the reveal of the foreground evidence barely registers. Do not publish as-is; re-render bolder with the foreground layer made less depth-sensitive so the big opening zoom survives.

rounds.verdict: The pull-back idea is right, but as rendered it is barely perceptible and the foreground reveal never happens. Across the six frames the composition is almost unchanged: t=0 is not tight on the runner as intended, it already shows the full window, bag, newspaper and baton, and t=1 is only marginally wider. The subject stays coherent with no tearing, doubled edges, ghosting or awkward frame clipping, the halftone-shimmer suits the 1950s offset-lithograph print style, and the final full plate is a good image to dwell on. However a plain centred move would look much the same, so the motion does not yet express the isolation or the discovery of the disputed place.
fixes: move damped to 75% (cut-2 26% off-frame at t=0.00)

filmIssues: The pull-back idea is right for isolation — opening on the runner and revealing the empty stadium and the disputed-selection objects below — but the rendered move is timid: after clamping the camera only goes from about 1.22 to 1.0, so in the contact sheet the six frames are nearly identical and the runner never dominates the opening frame.

The first frame is therefore not a strong opening picture: the runner is already small in the window and the bag, baton and newspaper are all already visible, so there is little discovery as the film proceeds and little sense of him shrinking into isolation.

The last frame is a good dwell picture — the full plate with window, track and table legible — but the journey to it is too small to read as a purposeful pull-back rather than a plain slight zoom-out, especially played in reverse.

No tearing, doubled edges, ghosting or awkward frame-edge clipping is visible; the baton stays coherent with the table. The halftone-shimmer is fitting and subtle for the offset-print style and does not damage coherence.
fixes: move damped to 56% (cut-2 36% off-frame at t=0.00)
